mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_document (knowledge_base_id, filename, content, embedding, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{knowledgeBaseId}, #{filename}, #{content}, #{embedding,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_document SET knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId}, filename = #{filename}, content = #{content}, embedding = #{embedding,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.JsonTypeHandler}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, filename, content, embedding, status, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, filename, content, embedding, status, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_document WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, filename, content, embedding, status, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, filename, content, embedding, status, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_document WHERE filename LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filename}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, filename, content, embedding, status, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_document ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, filename, content, embedding, status, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_document ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, knowledge_base_id, filename, content, embedding, status, created_at, updated_at FROM rag_document WHERE knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND filename = #{filename} LIMIT 1
